body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Suppress one Light Wound Condition's numerical penalties until the start of your next turn; the target gains +1 Harmony against pain-based effects during that time.

surges.html: Extend suppression through the end of your next turn.
Also suppress one ordinary fear or distraction penalty until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Rite - Imbuement
rider.html: Rite, 2 Echoes: bind the target. Trigger: it suffers Damage while a Wound penalty is suppressed. Echo: it may move 1 unit afterward. Damage and Wounds still apply.
